content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely temporary and on a contractual basis. Period of three years subject to annual review by the selection committee. The selected candidate will have no right or claim for regular or permanent appointment in this organization.

content_sections.text: Written Test Personal Interview Written Test to assess General Knowledge and Computer capability.
